greeting.speaker: LAB ASSISTANT
greeting.text: Crime Lab. Please keep your fingerprints off the evidence and your coffee off the microscope.

choices.text: What do you need me to do?
How is the lab holding up?
Thanks. I will get back to the case.

case_results.speaker: LAB ASSISTANT
case_results.text: I'll read out the delegated reports that are actually ready. The printer would like credit for its contribution.

remaining_work.speaker: LAB ASSISTANT
remaining_work.text: I can tell you exactly how much work remains. I cannot make the paperwork disappear. I have tried.

about_lab.speaker: LAB ASSISTANT
about_lab.text: The centrifuge is dramatic, the printer is hostile, and the coffee machine has refused to testify. Standard operating conditions.
